Cheren: Professor Juniper, I'm sorry
to have kept you waiting.{VAR BE01}

Cheren: She forgot to say that Pokémon
jump out at you in the tall grass.{VAR BE01}
I'm heading to Accumula Town, too.{VAR BE01}

Cheren: But we need to get going!
I'd imagine the professor's waiting, too.{VAR BE01}

Bianca: Me and {VAR 0101 0000}
will do the best for sure!{VAR BE01}

Cheren: {VAR 0100 0000}, are you going to
compare yourself with Bianca?{VAR BE01}
Both Bianca and I have two Pokémon
with us.

Bianca: Hmm...
Guess I'll be waiting here, then.{VAR BE01}
The Xtransceiver is ringing.
{VAR 0100 0000} picked up the Xtransceiver.{VAR BE01}
Cheren: Well, I'm going on ahead.{VAR BE01}

When your Pokémon's HP decreases,
they no longer have the energy to fight.{VAR BE01}
So, don't push your Pokémon too hard,
and let them rest often.
